You MUST decide if the OpenSpec change was correctly implemented and archived. If it was and there are changes to be pushed, you MUST create a new PR and move jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}} to "IN REVIEW" status. Otherwise, you MUST push all current changes to a feature branch and move jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}} to "DEVELOPMENT FAILED". You can use command `openspec list` to check if all OpenSpec changes were archived. It is not allowed to read or write files out of the current folder. If you need to write, use current tmp subfolder which is in .gitignore file.
